AI & Technology Analyst - Rotational Program

Richmond, Virginia, VA • Intelligent Systems
Job Type
Full-time
Description

LOCAL CANDIDATES ONLY (RICHMOND, VIRGINIA AREA) Ideal candidate will be 0-2 years post college graduate with an interest in AI Technology and Intelligent System spanning various roles within an Manufacturing and Technology company.  This role requires an AI- and technology-savvy, creative, motivated, entrepreneurial talent to participate in a two-year rotational program within Hyper. The program includes six four-month rotations. In each rotation, Program Members will complete a project aligned to two business functions, with the goal of identifying opportunities to apply AI and technology to improve productivity and optimize workflows.

Program participants will be embedded across six business functions over two years, driving AI and automation projects that ship into real workflows. They will have creative freedom, direct accountability, and a seat at the table with company executives from the first week.

 

Key Responsibilities

Identify and scope high-impact AI and automation opportunities within each business function 
Design, build, & deploy production-ready automations & AI-powered tools into business workflows 
Validate inputs, outputs, and data integrity; maintain thorough technical documentation 
Present project results and recommendations to senior leadership at the end of each rotation 
Partner with functional business leaders through weekly check-ins  
Continuously identify additional automation opportunities beyond the primary project 
Train incoming Program Members on your deployed solutions during rotation transitions 
Contribute to a growing automation library that benefits the entire organization 

Requirements
Recent college graduate or up to 2 years post-graduation with degrees in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering (or equivalent) 
Demonstrated exposure to computer science, software development, engineering, or business systems 
Hands-on experience applying AI tools and automation to real work — personal projects, internships, or coursework count 
High energy, intellectual curiosity, and strong problem-solving instincts 
Comfortable with ambiguity; you figure things out and don't wait to be told exactly what to do 
Strong communicator who can translate technical work into clear business outcomes 
Entrepreneurial mindset with a genuine drive to make things better, faster, and smarter 
Collaborative — you thrive building relationships across disciplines and levels of seniority 

Location & Travel

Based in Richmond, VA
Willing to travel to manufacturing partners and customer sites

Compensation

The anticipated starting salary is at $70,000 per year and up. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include, but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, and location. This hire will be eligible for a discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Variable compensation may depend on various factors, such as individual and organizational performance.

Hyper Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws.

Please note that Hyper Solutions is currently unable to offer visa sponsorship, and applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.

All applications will be used exclusively for selection purposes and handled confidentially by authorized personnel only. Your application may also be considered for other suitable positions within Hyper, Inc.
